gesting that visual representations enhance nu-
merical reasoning. This capability is further
improved by incorporating the reflection mod-
ule, which aids in the analysis and interpreta-
tion of complex data. We validate our findings
on NASDAQ STOCK dataset, where LLMs
demonstrate stronger reasoning with visual
data compared to text. Our code and data are
publicly available at https://github.com/
wekjsdvnm/Agent-Trading-Arena.git.
